ABOUT_ME.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT_ME.INTRO: Hello, my name is Marcel Berlin, and I am a frontend developer from Baesweiler, Germany. My interests for computers and everything related to them dates back to the mid-1990s. That's where I first gained experience in IT, and my fascination began. This fascination ultimately developed into a passion, and I decided to pursue a career as a front-end developer. I specialize in JavaScript and Angular and have experience developing web applications, business applications, responsive websites, and small browser games.
ABOUT_ME.TEXT1: I love constantly developing myself, implementing new ideas, and growing through challenges. Whether working alone or as part of a team, I always work in a structured and agile manner.
ABOUT_ME.TEXT2: Due to my expertise in the field of quality assurance, I work responsibly and have high standards for quality and user-friendliness.

SKILLS.TITLE: My Skills
SKILLS.SUBHEADLINE: I have gained profound experience in my frontend development skills that have allowed me to create different exciting projects.

PORTFOLIO.TITLE: Portfolio
PORTFOLIO.INTRO: The following applications are a small sample of my work - please feel free to try them out.

PROJECTS.DABubble: DaBubble is a group created collaborative communication platform that enables teams to chat in real-time, exchange files, and organize projects.
PROJECTS.Join: A group organizer for creating different tasks based on a Kanban-Board
PROJECTS.Sharkie: A simple Jump-and-Run game based on an object-oriented approach. Help Sharkie to find coins and poison bottles to fight against the killer whale.
